disagreements.title: Masthead link never reached in Tab walk (loan-open state)
disagreements.a_reason: Observed only with the loan-length list open: the Tab walk never leaves the listbox because Tab wraps among its options, so the header link is unreachable. The link itself is an ordinary header link; this is a symptom of the seeded keyboard trap, and fixing the trap fixes it.
disagreements.b_reason: The link is tabbable and is reached in the normal state; the walk failed only because the open loan-length listbox traps Tab (reported separately as F-0141). The finding misattributes that symptom to a working link and calls it severity 4.

disagreements.title: Every calendar day is a tab stop; over 20 presses to reach Reserve
disagreements.a_reason: Keyboard and switch users must Tab through all 21 day buttons on every tool page before reaching the primary action; a concrete, repeated cost for them. Not seeded (D08 is about the bar hiding focus).
disagreements.b_reason: One button per day is operable and common; the roving-tabindex grid is an efficiency preference, not a defect that blocks or misleads.

disagreements.title: Sticky Reserve bar hides the open loan-length options at 375 px
disagreements.a_reason: The fixed bar paints over interactive content at the bottom of the window, here the open listbox options; the same fixed-bar coverage problem as D08.
disagreements.b_reason: With the list open only 'One week' is visible and the other options sit under the fixed bar, so a phone member may not see they exist. Needs a stacking or flip fix, not D08's page padding.

disagreements.title: #reserve overlaps #tool-from under the spacing override at 320 px
disagreements.a_reason: The fixed bar painting over page content with nothing keeping the page clear of it; the same fixed-bar problem.
disagreements.b_reason: A fixed bar covering text at the bottom of the initial viewport is inherent to a sticky bar and the text scrolls into view; not a spacing failure. D08's harm is at the end of the page and on focused controls, not here.

disagreements.title: #reserve overlaps #tool-blurb at 200 % text size
disagreements.a_reason: The same fixed-bar coverage of page content.
disagreements.b_reason: Same checker artifact as F-0015: the fixed bar over scrollable header text, which remains reachable by scrolling.

assertions.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
